entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Oh shit...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait...!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why'd you come here, man!? And more[n]importantly, how!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! Is that how you speak to a woman!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you all right, Lady Ann!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Lady Ann...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, what is this thing? Is it alive?[n]How can it talk?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And... where in the world are we!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: J-Just calm down. Everything's going to[n]be okay; don't worry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How am I supposed to calm down!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: H-Huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why am I dressed like this!? When did I—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, what's with this!?
Calm down.
You look great.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How can you expect me to be calm!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What are you talking about!?[n]What the hell are you thinking!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I'm stumped...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A search party will be coming for us soon.[n]There's no time to explain.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't have a choice. Let's retreat[n]for now!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We were just gettin' fired up, and you[n]had to go and get in the way... Rgh, fine...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here... gimme your arm.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You take the other side.
